closure_requirements.purpose: Exactly what source material is required to close the outstanding provenance limitation (user directive point 6).
closure_requirements.required_material: Byte-accessible originals of the six controlling documents: Rev 4 (at minimum the byte ranges for §2.2.2 and §3.1–§3.3, plus unambiguous range delimiters), Rev 5 (§1–§13), Rev 6, Rev 6.1, Rev 6.2, Rev 6.3 — each as originally emitted. Two acceptance channels:
closure_requirements.channel_A_platform_export_preferred: A platform-origin transcript export (any lossless container: JSON, HTML, Markdown, or plain text) containing the six messages verbatim, delivered into the workspace (proposed path spike_evidence/spec/originals/). Requirements: (i) byte-exact message content preservation — no smart-quote substitution, whitespace collapsing, rewrapping, truncation, or rendering normalization; (ii) unambiguous per-message delimitation so byte ranges can be extracted; (iii) export tool/version identifier recorded for reproducibility.
closure_requirements.channel_B_user_attested_fallback: User-attested file copies of the six documents with an explicit recorded attestation that they are faithful copies of the originally emitted messages. This yields a weaker provenance grade; closure under Channel B would be recorded 'P0 PASS (provenance: user-attested)', not full platform provenance. Acceptability of the weaker grade is the user's decision.
closure_requirements.closure_procedure: Per document: (1) extract the declared byte range using the recorded boundary convention (H1 title line through final status line; rev4_extract: §2.2.2 and §3.1–§3.3 ranges); (2) compute SHA-256 over the original range; (3) byte-diff original range against the existing extract; (4) record per-document result (identical-within-declared-boundaries | divergence list). Then: extend SHA256SUMS to cover originals; write a closure amendment record; re-issue the P0 disposition ('P0 PASS' if all six compare identical within boundaries, else reconcile first). If any divergence is found, the original/export is authoritative: extracts are corrected only via superseding records with recomputed hashes — never silently edited.
closure_requirements.not_required_for_closure: No re-extraction from memory; no modification of the existing corpus; no execution of any experiment.
